# Some coins misbehave in the cave

### What happens
`recording.mp4` is an uncut run through a cave basin. Twice during the clip, Tux does something that releases a group of new coins. From the first of those moments until the end of the clip, the released coins do not behave the way coins in this game should. The coins that were already placed in the level, Tux, the animals and the scenery in the recording are correct.

### Expected
Each group of released coins should behave like a normal coin burst in this game, from the moment they spread out of their block until they come to rest and Tux goes back to collect them. Once a coin is within the basin's surrounding environment, it should drift down slowly, from the moment it enters it. Fix every way the released coins behave wrongly in the recording.

## Attached visual evidence

- `/app/.harbor_assets/recording.mp4` (47 seconds)

You can inspect individual moments of the video by extracting frames from it with `ffmpeg`.

Inspect the attached file before making changes.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Behavioral verifier. Resets every path test.patch touches to the immutable harbor_base tag, applies
# the hidden tests, runs ONLY the configured f2p + p2p tests with the repository's own runner into a
# JUnit report, and lets verifier.py turn that report into the reward. Nothing here reads the
# candidate's source to decide anything.
set -uo pipefail

# ---- task-specific values, filled by the task builder ----------------------------------------
# run_tests runs the configured tests with the repository's own runner and writes JUnit XML to
# $JUNIT_OUT. The test ids (f2p + p2p from /tests/config.json) are in $TEST_IDS_FILE, one per line.
# Write plain shell commands here; no quoting of the whole block is needed.
run_tests() {
  # The image flattens every timestamp under /app (environment/Dockerfile), the prebuilt objects in
  # build/ included. That leaves them older than the system headers they depend on, so ninja would
  # recompile all ~520 targets. Give each prebuilt output back the mtime ninja recorded for it in
  # .ninja_log (and build.ninja, which cmake writes, the harbor_base snapshot time) so only sources
  # that actually changed since the image was built are recompiled.
  python3 - <<'PY' >&2
import os, subprocess
b = "/app/build"
last = {}
try:
    with open(os.path.join(b, ".ninja_log")) as f:
        for line in f:
            p = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
            if len(p) >= 4 and p[2].isdigit():
                last[p[3]] = int(p[2])
except OSError:
    pass
n = 0
for rel, ns in last.items():
    path = os.path.join(b, rel)
    try:
        if os.stat(path).st_mtime_ns < ns:
            os.utime(path, ns=(ns, ns))
            n += 1
    except OSError:
        pass
try:
    t = int(subprocess.run(["git", "-C", "/app", "log", "-1", "--format=%ct", "harbor_base"],
                           capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip())
    bn = os.path.join(b, "build.ninja")
    if os.stat(bn).st_mtime < t:
        os.utime(bn, (t, t))
        n += 1
except (ValueError, OSError):
    pass
print("restored build mtimes: %d" % n)
PY
  cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)" >&2

  BIN=/app/build/supertux2
  DIR=/app/tests/integration
  WLOG="$(mktemp)"
  BLOG="$(mktemp)"
  RLOG="$(mktemp)"
  OLOG="$(mktemp)"

  # The levels never quit on their own: each script prints its samples and then a *_DONE marker
  # (water script ~30 simulated s, burst script ~15, repeat-burst script ~18, out-of-view script
  # ~5). The game is stopped as soon as the marker is in its log; 80 s stays as the hard cap.
  run_level() {
    timeout -k 5 80 stdbuf -oL -eL "$BIN" --renderer null --disable-sound --disable-music "$1" > "$2" 2>&1 &
    local pid=$!
    while kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null && ! grep -q "$3" "$2"; do sleep 0.5; done
    kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null
    wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null
    return 0
  }
  run_level "$DIR/heavycoin_water_test.stl" "$WLOG" COINY_DONE
  run_level "$DIR/heavycoin_burst_test.stl" "$BLOG" BURST_DONE
  run_level "$DIR/heavycoin_repeat_test.stl" "$RLOG" REPEAT_DONE
  run_level "$DIR/heavycoin_offscreen_test.stl" "$OLOG" FAR_DONE

  python3 "$DIR/evaluate_heavycoin.py" "$WLOG" "$BLOG" "$RLOG" "$OLOG" "$JUNIT_OUT" $(cat "$TEST_IDS_FILE")
}
# Directories holding the repo's test plumbing (configs, helpers) that must also be restored so a
# candidate cannot replace the harness. Space-separated, relative to /app; '' if none.
PROTECTED_DIRS=''

+                    "at y~%.0f by then)" % (late, FLOOR_REST)))

+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.released_coins_can_be_collected", have_burst and total >= 3,
+                    "zones=%r (expected Tux to pick up the released coins when he sweeps the floor: "
+                    ">= 3 picked up in total)" % (zones,)))
+

+                    have_burst and total >= 9,
+                    "zones=%r: %d of the block's 10 coins ended up on the floor (expected >= 9: every "
+                    "coin of the burst is thrown out and comes down)" % (zones, total)))
+

+    right = zones.get("right_in", 0) + zones.get("right_out", 0)
+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.scatters_to_both_sides",
+                    have_burst and left >= 2 and right >= 2,
+                    "zones=%r: %d coins landed clearly left of the block, %d clearly right of it "
+                    "(expected >= 2 on each side)" % (zones, left, right)))
+

+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.landed_coins_come_to_rest",
+                    have_burst and total >= 3 and far == 0,
+                    "zones=%r: %d coins were found more than 1000px from the block 8 seconds after "
+                    "the burst (expected 0: a landed coin should come to rest instead of travelling on)" % (zones, far)))

+    sys.stderr.write("repeat zones: %r\n" % (rzones,))

+    results.append(("HeavyCoinBurstTest.every_burst_comes_down",

+                    "repeat zones=%r (expected >= 9 of the 10 coins of EACH burst to be picked up within "

+    kept = all(v is not None and v != "GONE" for v in far_vals)

+                    "Tux picked up %r coins when he went down to the coin (expected 1)" % (picked,)))

+

+    main()
